about: Well-known and custom TCP port map for service identification during VAJRA scans. Keys are port numbers as strings; categories follow pentest workflow groupings.

7.notes: echo protocol; rarely active today, TCP ping fun

21.notes: FTP; clear-text creds, bounce scan potential

25.notes: SMTP; open relay, user enumeration via VRFY

37.notes: time protocol; clock skew, historic exploits

53.notes: DNS over TCP; AXFR, cache poisoning checks

80.notes: HTTP; primary web enumeration and testing

135.notes: Windows RPC endpoint mapper; DCOM abuse

161.notes: SNMP; weak community strings leak data

531.notes: AOL IM; also legacy alternate IRC

901.notes: Samba Web Admin; 'mystery' in legacy lists

1000.notes: unassigned; start of high port range

1025.notes: AOL service; often Win RPC dynamic

1433.notes: MS SQL Server; SA account attacks
